items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Barney Bigard used to do that... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: But he plays the same solo on whatever the tune is, everytime it's played. And a lot of guys used to do that. Barney Bigard used to do that, you know, one -- if they were going to play "Tiger Rag" then he always played this solo. If they were going to play whatever it was, "A Closer Walk With Thee," you'd always hear the same solo, sort of worked the same melody, beautiful solos.
